title: סיום יום in the middle, and every area says its name
question: Your two rules, built. Moving the reflection into the hub is what made the words possible: seven on the arc instead of eight, and the earlier round already proved eight Hebrew names collide at every size. Three ways to find the room. Two of them have defects I am not hiding.

options.label: A · one arc
options.thesis: Seven areas on one wide arc, each with its word under it, and סיום יום as a large raised hub carrying the moon and its own name. Nothing collides and nothing is cut.
options.viewport: Seven named discs around a named hub.
options.risk: האנשים שלי is the longest name and its halo just touches the disc beside it. One point of type size, or one word shorter, settles it.

options.label: B · two arcs
options.thesis: Four on an outer arc and three on an inner one, so every name has twice the arc length to sit in.
options.risk: DEFECT: the outer arc runs off both edges - תזונה on one side and תובנות on the other are cut. It also stops reading as one shape and starts reading as two rows.

options.label: C · a staggered arc
options.thesis: One arc, but every other disc sits further out, so no two names are ever at the same height and they cannot collide.
options.viewport: A zigzag arc around the hub.
options.risk: DEFECT: the outer radius is too wide for a 376px phone and the two end areas are cut off. The idea survives a smaller radius; this capture does not.
